name: hightouch
description: Hightouch marketing stack — gated workspace MCP (schema, data, audiences, journeys, creatives, syncs) plus public read-only docs and Agent API MCPs

requirements: Hightouch must enable the MCP server for the workspace — it is gated, not self-serve
Workspace role that allows the requested actions (operations respect the workspace RBAC)
notes: config.url is null on purpose: the workspace MCP endpoint is provisioned by Hightouch and is not published. The public docs MCP (https://docs.hightouch.com/mcp) and the read-only Agent API MCP (https://hightouch.com/agent-api/mcp) are listed under source.
The workspace marketing-stack MCP is GATED: Hightouch enables it per workspace and its endpoint URL is not published here.
Public docs-only MCP (no auth): https://docs.hightouch.com/mcp (Search / Read pages / Submit feedback).
Read-only public Agent API MCP: https://hightouch.com/agent-api/mcp (search + fetch), with https://hightouch.com/agent-api/v1/info and https://hightouch.com/agent-api/openapi.json.
MCP access carries no extra charge; the underlying product usage still applies.
All workspace operations are scoped to the authenticated workspace and respect its RBAC.

REST fallback for everything the gated MCP cannot do: https://api.hightouch.com with a bearer key (HIGTOUCH_API_KEY). The workspace OAuth metadata is live at https://mcp-auth.hightouch.com/oauth2/{authorize,token,register,device_authorization}, so a client can be built before the endpoint URL is disclosed.
